mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate level below 0.1% indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces equity discount rates, compressing the cost of capital for corporations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.1%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 6.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, directly causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 6.5, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in FEDFUNDS and rise in CPIAUCSL indicates central bank's aggressive easing during inflation, which boosts equity valuations through growth expectations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction term (FEDFUNDS change * CPIAUCSL change) has Rank IC below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or positive returns occur in less than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines and CPIAUCSL rises.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 2.5% YoY), a federal funds rate decline signals aggressive monetary easing that supports equity valuations, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 2.5% YoY and FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained growth in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust manufacturing expansion that supports corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is rising, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Non-farm payrolls growth exceeding 200,000 jobs signals strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate profits, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS growth exceeds 200,000, or Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand that drives corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through demand momentum.
failure_condition: The interaction term (HOUST change * RSAFS change) has Rank IC below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or positive returns occur in less than 40% of instances when both series rise.

mechanism_narrative: In housing boom regimes (HOUST > 1,500,000 units), a declining unemployment rate signals tightening labor markets that support housing demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 1,500,000 and UNRATE declines, or Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.
